questions.question: Using sigmac translate the "C:\Rules\sigma\file_event_win_app_dropping_archive.yml" Sigma rule into the equivalent Splunk search. Then, navigate to http://[Target IP]:8000, open the "Search & Reporting" application, and submit the Splunk search sigmac provided. Enter the TargetFilename value of the returned event as your answer.
questions.hint: You can find sigmac inside the previous section's target, if you don't have it readily available.
